content.content:
read README.md lines 1-4/4
1: # cassette-player
2: 
3: A command-line tool that records HTTP exchanges once and replays them byte for byte. It keeps chunk boundaries, refuses requests it never recorded, and never stores credentials.
4:

read docs/guide.md lines 1-11/11
1: # Guide
2: 
3: ## Record
4: Run `cassette-player record --out <file>` and point your client at the printed URL.
5: 
6: ## Replay
7: Run `cassette-player replay <file>`; unmatched requests get a 401 naming their key.
8: 
9: ## Matching
10: Requests match by route, model, the first user message and their item count.
11:

read CHANGELOG.md lines 1-12/12
1: # Changelog
2: 
3: ## 0.3.0
4: - Paced replay keeps background children in order.
5: - Tool sets are stored once per cassette.
6: 
7: ## 0.2.0
8: - Stop is recorded as a client-aborted stream.
9: 
10: ## 0.1.0
11: - First recorder and replay.
12:

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_askUser
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Ask the user a clarifying question and WAIT for their answer (the run pauses). Provide options for a structured choice (selectionMode multi_select allows several), or omit options for a free-text question

options.description:
Optional choices. Omit for a free-text question.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 10

description.description:
Optional context for the option (does not change the answer value).
constraints: maximum length 1000

label.description:
Option label; the value returned when chosen.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

question.description:
The clear, specific question to ask the user.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 2000

selectionMode.description: How many options the user may pick. Requires options; defaults to single_select.

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_executeCommand
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Run a shell command for tests, builds, git, and other tools. NO sandbox: it can read or change anything the user can. Never run destructive commands unless explicitly requested. Requires per-call approval by default. Starts in a chosen open root; kills the process tree on timeout. Returns exitCode, bounded stdout/stderr tail, and durationMs

command.description:
Shell command passed verbatim to `-c`; NO sandbox
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 10000

cwd.description: Start directory, absolute or root-relative; must resolve inside an open folder

root.description: Open-folder name/id; required only with multiple folders

timeoutMs.description:
Process-tree timeout ms (default 120000, max 600000)
constraints: lower than or equal to 600000, greater than 0

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_globWorkspace
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Enumerate workspace files whose path matches a glob (e.g. **/*.test.ts, src/**/*.tsx). One path per result line, prefixed with its root name when several folders are open. Excludes .git, build output, and gitignored paths by default; pass includeIgnored to see them; read-only

includeIgnored.description: Include excluded paths: build output, generated artifacts, and gitignored files such as coverage/ or .env* (default false)

limit.description:
Match cap (default 200)
constraints: lower than or equal to 1000, greater than 0

offset.description:
Pagination offset
constraints: greater than or equal to 0, lower than or equal to 100000

pattern.description:
Workspace-relative glob; bare patterns match at any depth
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 500

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit to search all of this thread's folders. Results include their root.

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_grepSearch
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Grep indexed and live on-disk file content for an exact string or regex. Default 'files' mode surveys matching paths cheaply; 'content' mode (scoped with filePaths) returns matches grouped under one file header per file — 'root:path' when several folders are open — with 'line: text' rows ('-' marks opt-in context rows). Reuse that root and path (and the row's line number as startLine) in readWorkspaceFile calls

contextLines.description:
Context lines around each 'content' match (default 0; opt in when needed)
constraints: greater than or equal to 0, lower than or equal to 5

filePaths.description:
Restrict to these files: workspace-relative, or absolute inside an open folder
constraints: maximum length 1000

maxResults.description:
'content' match cap (default 50)
constraints: lower than or equal to 200, greater than 0

offset.description:
Pagination offset
constraints: greater than or equal to 0, lower than or equal to 2000

outputMode.description: 'files' (default): paths + match counts. 'content': matching lines; narrow with filePaths.

pattern.description:
Exact text (default) or JavaScript regex
constraints: minimum length 2, maximum length 500

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit to search all of this thread's folders. Results include their root.

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_readToolOutputArtifact
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Page/grep; never alter or recreate the cursor.

cursor.description:
Prior cursor; copy byte-for-byte, never edit or recreate it.
constraints: minimum length 1, maximum length 2048

maxBytes.description: constraints: greater than or equal to 4, lower than or equal to 8000

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_readWorkspaceFile
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Read a file from a chosen open workspace root as bounded, line-numbered pages with a short thread-scoped continuation handle. For later pages pass only cursor (and optional maxChars); omit path/root/startLine/endLine

cursor.description: Short nextCursor handle from the previous page. Pass it unchanged with optional maxChars and omit every other field

anyOf.description: constraints: input must match this regex ^rfh_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$

endLine.description: Last 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

anyOf.description: constraints: lower than or equal to 50000, greater than 0

path.description: Workspace-relative file path; required only when starting a new read

root.description: Open-folder name/id. Omit for this thread's primary folder; an explicit root always wins.

startLine.description: First 1-based line; omit with cursor unless replaying the original value unchanged

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: brainstrike_stringReplaceWorkspaceFile
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Surgically edit a file in a chosen open workspace root by replacing one oldStr block with newStr (fuzzy-matched; refuses ambiguous matches; refuses if the file changed on disk since you last read it — re-read and retry; workspace-scoped, requires approval). matchType "exact" confirms verbatim placement; other matchTypes are fuzzy — re-read for precision

newStr.description:

98fb893a6fccedd9.name: search_tools
98fb893a6fccedd9.description: Search deferred capabilities this run: canvas documents, task lists, skill scripts, Python, browser pages, web search/extract, command sessions, git worktrees, file delete/rename, directory listings, workspace context, symbol and LSP inspection, embedding search, diagnostics, including MCP tools, by keyword.
